accounting_rules: Annual cashflow growth is applied to cashflow after operating expenses and before replacement CAPEX; it is a scenario assumption, not a measured AI effect.
Automation and R&D project yields are incremental net residual yields after incremental OPEX and replacement obligations.
Automation project returns begin after the stated deployment lag and stop after the stated benefit life.
R&D returns are probability-weighted expected values; failed projects generate zero return and are not assumed to recover principal.
Fund allocations are transfers of verified residual into investment or reserve uses, not additional consolidated value.
Negative residual first draws the reserve; any remaining amount is reported as an unfunded reproduction gap.
No debt, token issuance, valuation gains, price-only increases, or internal transfers are counted as operating gains.
The model does not automatically reduce productive capital when a gap is unfunded; it reports the gap explicitly.
